# @recon-fuzz/mcp-knowledge

> MCP server that makes Recon documentation searchable by AI tools.

## Tools (14)

### Site tools (getrecon.xyz)
- search_glossary: Search glossary terms — returns top 5 matching terms with full definitions
- get_blog_post: Get a blog post by slug — returns full content, metadata, and URL
- get_comparison: Get a comparison article by slug — returns both entities, strengths, conclusion, FAQs
- search_site: Search all site content — returns top 10 matches across blog posts, glossary, comparisons, tools
- list_tools: List all developer tools — returns tool names, descriptions, and URLs

### Book tools (book.getrecon.xyz)
- get_book_chapter: Get a book chapter by slug — returns full content, category, URL
- get_book_concept: Get a technical concept by slug — returns detailed explanation
- search_book: Search book content — returns top 10 matches across chapters and concepts
- list_book_chapters: List all book chapters — returns chapters grouped by category

### Substack tools (getrecon.substack.com)
- get_substack_post: Get a newsletter post by slug — returns full content
- search_substack: Search Substack posts — returns top 10 matches
- list_substack_posts: List all Substack posts — returns posts sorted by date

### Cross-source
- search_all: Search across all 3 sources — returns top 15 matches from site, book, and Substack
- refresh_cache: Re-fetch all sources — rate limited to once per minute

## Data sources
- Site: https://getrecon.xyz/llms-full.txt
- Book: https://book.getrecon.xyz/llms-full.txt
- Substack: https://getrecon.substack.com (RSS feed)

## Setup

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "recon-knowledge": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@recon-fuzz/mcp-knowledge"]
    }
  }
}
```

No API key needed. The server fetches public documentation only.

## Privacy

This server is read-only. It fetches from hardcoded public URLs only. No user queries, tool arguments, or any data is sent to Recon or any third party. No telemetry, no analytics, no tracking.
